response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS e, f.facetfaces AS ff FROM scanmesh f JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = f.zoneref), base AS (SELECT AVG(ff) AS b FROM m), site AS (SELECT z, e, AVG(ff) AS a FROM m GROUP BY z, e HAVING AVG(ff) IS NOT NULL), st AS (SELECT e, AVG(a) AS sa FROM site WHERE e IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e), kept AS (SELECT site.a AS a, base.b AS b, st.sa AS sa FROM site JOIN st ON site.e = st.e CROSS JOIN base WHERE site.a > st.sa AND base.b IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept_site_avg, AVG(a - b) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - sa) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Sites with no non-null facetfaces have no average, so they are excluded from the status averages and from the kept sites. Sites with a NULL entrystat are excluded from the status comparison but their mesh records still count in the baseline.
If no baseline can be computed or no site qualifies, the single result row contains NULLs.
